units.source_text: 牛的喉咙里发出了硬塞进马口铁哨子的声音，远处，公鸡啼鸣了。

en.t: A sound came from the cow's throat like a tin whistle being forced into it, and in the distance a rooster crowed.

units.source_text: 可是，在沙子的洞穴中，既没有距离感也没有方向感。

en.t: But inside the hole in the sand, there was no sense of distance and no sense of direction.

units.source_text: 但是，除了这里，外面有正常的世界，孩子们在路边踢着石子玩耍，也毫无违和，

en.t: But apart from this place, there was a normal world outside, where children playing by kicking pebbles along the roadside would not seem out of place at all,

units.source_text: 时间一到，如同往常一样报告着黎明的到来。

en.t: and when the time came, it announced the arrival of dawn just as usual.

units.source_text: 这么一说，连炊饭的香气里，也渗进了黎明之色。

en.t: Come to think of it, even the smell of cooking rice had taken on the color of dawn.
